conventions.byte_strings: Every *_hex field is lowercase hex without separators.
conventions.expected: expected is the JSON the HTTP route renders. Binary decoders must reach the same values.
conventions.record_hex: record_hex is one record envelope as a response carries it. body_hex is the body alone.
conventions.refused: Every refused vector must fail to decode or validate. Query and HTTP refusals are invalid_command.
conventions.request_hex: request_hex is the command payload without framing. http_query is the query string of GET /metadata/changes.
conventions.u128_values: 128-bit values (log ids, checksums, client ids) are 32 lowercase hex characters in JSON.
conventions.u64_values: Ops and timestamps are JSON numbers below 2^53 in every vector except large_values, which carries them as decimal strings.
conventions.unknown_kinds: A record of an unknown group or kind is kept with its codes and raw body, never refused.
